# Clipra

> AI-powered video repurposing. Upload long videos and get viral-ready short clips with captions in minutes.

Clipra turns long-form videos into short, viral-ready clips with AI captions and viral scoring. Built for creators, agencies, and marketers who want to dominate short-form algorithms without spending hours editing.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, and FAQ.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free, Starter, and Creator plans with monthly minute limits.
